about: Native, sample-free Ageispolis first transcription. Fixed official SAW85-92 album master. Six-stem note/kit-unit guides, not actual MIDI/instrument identity. AI695246rev851954 consulted only/unverified and not used as performed score. No speech, no reference samples, no tape/hiss/wow model. See ageispolis-r1 evidence. r12: bass re-transcribed from the bass stem (722 onsets, harmonic-salience pitch with an octave check, +40 ms onset calibration) after octave fixes; FM pluck darker (FM index burst 4 -> 1, LP 2.5k) and wider (chorus), +6 dB; master contour rides and half-strength band-width refits.
